title: Great trip with Marian Gorban
text: The day trip was excellent!  Marian Gorban, our guide, was extremely knowledgeable and very professional!!  He allowed us to customize our trip, which made it much more enjoyable.  This was an all day trip and was worth every penny!!
author: William_B

title: Touring with a friend
text: Guide was friendly and created a unique, memorable experience on every stop.  It’s like you are traveling with another friend
author: danielle_t

title: Perfect day
text: Our guide showed up promptly, was very personable, and knowlegible of locations visited. Also translated for us as well. Highly recommend this tour
author: Ernie_H

title: Amazing
text:
Amazing. The trip was well planned. Sandra was a very good driver, a knowledgeable guide and very friendly. 
Very satisfied. A great day
author: JosephineDiacono
